01 / ABOUT METHE HUMAN LAYER

Start with curiosity.
Learn by doing.

I’m Kerim, a junior AI engineer exploring RAG, large language models, prompt engineering and AI workflow systems.

I learn by building and measuring. My projects range from document-based chatbots and visual workflows to evaluating model routing on MMLU and GSM8K. I’m interested in where models succeed, where they fail, and how quality, cost and latency interact. I also have hands-on experience with MongoDB, Milvus and Docker.

EXPERIMENT_002m↗MODEL ROUTING / EVALUATION
EVALUATION PROJECT COMPLETED STUDY

Model Router + Eval

Comparing three language models on MMLU & GSM8K, then testing Decisions-based escalation to understand the trade-offs between accuracy, cost and latency.

PythonOpenAI / DecisionsLLM evaluation

What the evaluation showed.

200 questions, split into 120 development and 80 test cases. The fixed routing policy scored 75/80 on the test split, matching the Luna baseline with higher estimated cost.

The study compares baselines and routing policies, documenting when escalation helps and when a stronger model can make an answer worse.

PERSONAL PROJECT IN DEVELOPMENT

Keryon

A visual AI workflow project where I bring together what I’m learning. I’m experimenting with LLM calls, document retrieval and workflows in one application.

Python / FastAPILangChainMongoDBMilvus

Keryon as a learning space.

Building workflows in a visual editor helps me learn how APIs, storage and LLM integrations fit together. The project uses FastAPI, React Flow, LangChain, MongoDB and Milvus Lite. It gives me practice with document retrieval, response validation and execution logs.

Simple RAG Chatbot

An earlier hands-on project exploring how a chatbot can answer using a custom knowledge base. I connected Gemini with document retrieval in Milvus and conversation history in MongoDB, behind a FastAPI backend.

A starting point for learning how retrieval, prompts and chat history fit together.
